names: wakes an agent that cannot load its session with the conversation replayed, not only the result
dispatches a hand-off into a free slot without waiting for whole-bot idle, and holds the next at capacity
gives a member a line posted while its turn ran once, in its next turn, under the provenance note
open() re-parks a root on its cards without a new item, and reruns a cut root once before failing it interrupted
outwardDetail dedupes, trims and clips the labels, names at most four as verb phrases, and keeps the exact prefix and close
R-S3 restart: a parked root is re-parked with its cards and no new item; a cut root reruns once and ends interrupted on a second cut
R-S8 a cut turn whose outward list is empty reruns once in place, as before: the port is asked once per cut node
R-S9 a cut turn that already acted outward is not rerun: failed(interrupted) with what it did, reported; a root into its own conversation, a child to its requester with the restart note
renders the last window of a room as one member reads it
puts the provenance note on the reader's own post for every other reader
offers a line that arrived while its turn ran once, on the next turn, marked as older
work a guest's turn hands a teammate is the guest's too: the teammate runs confined
waits for a busy peer, then resumes the same routine as a routine turn and records the final report
S1 assigns a teammate under the envelope and resumes the Chief once with the report
R1 a routine run coordinates a teammate, waits, and completes through a routine resume turn
fails closed when LIST gives a remembered Boat id an unexpected name
keeps the fence when Boat blocks a delete without a documented stage
runs a teammate turn whose Auto VPS is unavailable, telling the model why instead of failing it
refuses proxied OAuth starts even for an authenticated admin
refuses ambiguous old-phone actions and keeps explicit A actions on A while B is selected
refuses a write for a read-only bot with the connector scope text and a decision row
refuses a tool outside the bot's grant without naming the others
refuses a read-only bot's write before any request and records nothing
gives a bot its scoped tools, records writes without contact data, refreshes once, signs out on revocation and disconnects
resumes the source session and gives it each of three results exactly once, with a long brief
keeps provenance and exactly-once delivery across rework rounds to the same teammate
resumes a Chief whose own turn a restart cut after it sent work, once that work settles (%s)
ends a Chief's review a second restart cuts, and says so in its conversation
gives a replacement session the full assignment when a result returns after its resume was rejected
gives an engine switched in while a teammate works the full assignment when the result returns
hands work on as outside content, never as the person's request
frames room work it cannot trace as outside content, and defuses forged envelopes both ways
carries the recorded macOS permission failure into the failed turn
